study_role: prospective software/runtime intervention study; never reinterpret or reopen the closed 358H hardware campaign

fixed_semantics.target: Qwen3-8B Q8_0 on explicit llama.cpp Vulkan0
fixed_semantics.draft: same frozen Qwen3-0.6B OpenVINO INT4 IR
fixed_semantics.acceptance: ordered prefix; stop at first mismatch
fixed_semantics.correction: one target token at first mismatch
fixed_semantics.bonus: one target token after complete draft acceptance
fixed_semantics.primary_timing_boundary: post target-prompt-prefill decode; all runtime-specific draft initialization, checkpoint, proposal, reconciliation, fallback, and cleanup are inside the measured boundary

research_questions.rq1: Can persistent/reconcilable draft state reduce realized draft-subsystem cost relative to full committed-prefix replay without changing token semantics?
research_questions.rq2: Can a physically wider target verification path (n_ubatch=2) pass the active exact-output contract and reduce target-side realized cost?
research_questions.rq3: After counting every state-management and target-side cost, does a correctness-qualified combined runtime path improve post-prefill decode time relative to target-only?
research_questions.rq4: If a component improves but the whole path remains unprofitable, can the runtime expose that outcome without relabeling it as a system speedup?

R0.purpose: capability discovery and forced state-machine qualification
required: OpenVINO model I/O and query_state capability inventory
request reset and cross-request leakage test
target UB1 and UB2 binding/state tests

R1.purpose: correctness qualification of complete candidate execution paths before performance promotion

small_gate.pass_rule: all paired generated token-ID sequences exactly equal the shared UB1 target-only reference

full_gate.pass_rule: 90/90 exact pairs; one mismatch blocks the path from performance promotion

R2.purpose: paired component and end-to-end comparison of only R1-qualified paths
R2.condition_selection: deterministic from R0/R1 feasibility and exactness only; never from observed performance
R2.schedule: within each task/repetition block, randomize all eligible conditions using a frozen seed
R2.warmup: HumanEval/0 only; non-formal and excluded from estimators

legacy_replay.role: contemporaneous bridge to the closed Phase-3 mechanism

same_frontend_replay.draft_frontend: state-capable OpenVINO/Optimum adapter selected and frozen in R0
same_frontend_replay.role: control for frontend changes when estimating state-reuse benefit

persistent_ub2.promotion: only if the complete device/frontend/state/UB2 path passes R1 90/90 exactness

legacy_replay_ub2_fallback.promotion: may be qualified only when persistent state is unavailable and UB2 remains a scientifically useful independent intervention

hard_block_rules: any generated-token mismatch against the active target-only reference
requested execution device differs from actual execution device
AUTO, MULTI, HETERO, or silent CPU inference fallback for a single-device claim
persistent path performs hidden full-prefix replay after begin
draft logical history differs from committed orchestrator history after reconcile
target KV/logical history differs from committed orchestrator history
runtime-specific setup/checkpoint/reconcile/cleanup moved outside the primary measured decode boundary
formal condition chosen using R1 or R2 timing performance

estimators.primary_system: for each prompt take the median paired target-only/runtime speedup across repetitions; report geometric mean across 30 prompts
estimators.primary_component: same-frontend replay versus persistent realized draft-subsystem time using prompt-level paired ratios
secondary: target verification ratio UB2/UB1 where jointly qualified
mean committed tokens per speculative round C

interpretation_rules: reduced draft cost with total speedup <= 1 is component improvement without overall profitability
a correctness-blocked path retains diagnostic timing only
an unavailable NPU state API is IMPLEMENTATION UNAVAILABLE, not a reason to substitute CPU/AUTO/replay and call it persistent NPU
no result changes the scientific status of the closed hardware campaign

deferred.profitability_guard: architecture hook may be implemented, but no formal adaptive-policy claim is made in R2; a measured guard requires a separately frozen R3 protocol
